d: Our Client, a Leading Financial Services company in Kuwait is looking out for a Compliance Head to be based at Kuwait.

We are looking at individuals who have been working in the Compliance Function for leading Financial Services/ Foreign Exchange/ Payments organisation with experience in the GCC (Gulf region). Experience in Kuwait market and Arabic Language proficiency is an added advantage.
Candidates should be a Finance Graduate or MBA with desired experience in managing end to end Compliance in a Large Financial Services/ Payments/ Foreign Exchange Company.
r: Conduct periodic internal reviews or audits to ensure that compliance procedures are followed.
Key responsibility for day-to-day monitoring and reporting of compliance risks.
Conduct or direct the internal investigation of compliance issues.
Create a design to maintain records of compliance activities, including any complaints or investigations.

Establish a compliance testing plan, and conduct compliance checking through random samples to ensure that the company is in compliance with internal policy and produces and Central Bank rules and regulation.

Responsible to ensure the all staff are fully aware (the related instructions) of the policy and procedures, KYC (Know your Customer) and SAR (Suspicious Activity Report) related instructions and to implement them accurately.
Liaise with internal departments on Compliance, AML CFT related matters.
Identifying suspicious transaction and raise alert.
Develop all policies and procedures related to compliance activities, AML and CFT, and make sure that all policies and procedure are followed.
Review compliance policies and procedures on a regular basis to ensure they comply with Central Bank requirements.
Adherence to Anti-Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism Laws.
Assess product, compliance, or operational risks and develop risk management strategies.
Assist with the compliance risk assessment process ensuring that the compliance risks are appropriately identified and assessed.
Provide reports to the Management, highlighting any areas of potential risk to the company.
Coordinate with Central Bank representatives during any inquiry, investigation or audits and acts as the main focal point.
Coordinate / engage will regulators as and when required.
Communicate any major change in AML policies/procedure among the branches based on instructions received by the Central Bank from time to time.
Respond to correspondent bank queries on AML.
Monitor compliance systems to ensure their effectiveness.
Working closely with IT department to ensure that Compliance system working properly and as per company requirements.
Working closely with IT / Vendors on development on AML system for sanction screening and transaction monitoring.
Authority to access systems and checking any documents as required.
Liaise with training department for training of employees on AML & CFT.
Effectively lead and develop the compliance team, in line with department goals, objectives and systems, monitor and evaluate their performance.
Provide a proper motivation and coaching for compliance team
Ensure team receives necessary training and development as per job level to reflect on their capabilities and customer service.

d: C2i is a forward-thinking company shaping the future of retail, hospitality, and lifestyle through innovation, operational excellence, and strategic partnerships.
Driven by a customer-first approach, we curate world-class brands and develop distinctive concepts that create long-term value for our partners, communities, and stakeholders.

As an IT Officer at C2i, you will be responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing the company's IT infrastructure and systems to support seamless business operations. You will provide technical assistance, manage hardware and software, maintain network security, and oversee data backup and recovery processes.
This role is essential in ensuring the reliability, security, and efficiency of IT systems across the organization, enabling teams to work effectively and deliver operational excellence.
r: Maintain and optimize IT equipment and systems, including servers, desktop computers, laptops, printers, and security software.
Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network-related issues.
Implement and manage data backup processes to ensure reliable storage, recovery, and business continuity.
Monitor system performance and identify opportunities for upgrades, improvements, or equipment replacement.
Install, configure, and maintain networks, servers, operating systems, and software applications.
Implement and monitor IT security measures, including antivirus protection, endpoint security, and password management policies.
Ensure the security, reliability, and performance of IT systems in line with company policies and IT standards.
Support the implementation of appropriate access controls and data protection measures.
Provide timely technical support to employees and end users in person, over the phone, or through remote support tools.
Install, configure, and maintain operating systems, business applications, and IT hardware.
Create and manage user accounts, configure user profiles, and resolve access and password-related issues.
Assist with the deployment, testing, and implementation of new applications, systems, and technologies.
Manage and prioritize IT support requests, ensuring issues are resolved within agreed service levels.
Coordinate with external IT vendors and service providers for hardware maintenance, software support, and hosting services.
Maintain accurate IT asset inventories, technical documentation, and system records.
Follow established IT procedures and conduct routine safety checks on IT equipment.
Build effective working relationships with employees, business stakeholders, vendors, and technical teams.
Identify opportunities to improve IT processes, system performance, and end-user experience.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Minimum of 4 years of experience in IT support, IT operations, or a similar technical role.
Previous experience in IT helpdesk or end-user support is preferred.
Practical experience in troubleshooting hardware, software, operating systems, and network connectivity.
Experience supporting business applications, managing IT assets, and coordinating with external service providers is an advantage.
Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Good knowledge of operating systems, networking, and IT infrastructure.
Familiarity with IT service management processes and ticketing systems.
Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple requests.
Excellent communication and customer service skills.
Ability to evaluate, test, and implement new technologies.
Proactive approach to identifying issues and improving IT operations.
Ability to work collaboratively with teams across different business functions.

Join C2i and contribute to a technology-driven environment that supports innovation, operational excellence, and business growth across retail, hospitality, and lifestyle. You will play a key role in maintaining secure, reliable, and efficient IT systems that empower our teams and enhance the overall business experience.

d: KBR’s Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) group is looking for a Lead HSE Engineer to support HSE function on PMC Project with Kuwait Oil Company in Kuwait.
The Lead HSE engineer will coordinate implementation of the KOC PMC Safety policies, HSE Management System and Project specific HSE Management Plans as they apply to the project.
He will ensure that the site complies with the relevant HSE Legislation and KOC HSE requirements.
He will develop and implement the project HSE MS.
He will develop and maintain Statistical data for the Project and prepare reports as required for the KBR KOC PMC HSEQ Manager.
q: Minimum 8 years Oil & Gas post-graduation experience
Minimum 5 years’ experience in a Lead HSE Engineer role.
Practical experience of design, construction, commissioning and maintenance aspects of oil/gas installations.

Practical experience with HSE management systems, reporting and audit procedures. Excellent written coordination and verbal communication skills. Ability to develop, update and maintain in-house procedures. Must be conversant with local and international saftey standards and norms.

Must possess two or more HSE certifications (certified courses) in General Industrial Safety, Construction Safety, Environmental Management, industrial Hygiene, ISO 14001 / OHSAS 18001 Lead Auditor, NEBOSH, ICertOSH, ASSE Certificate in Global Safety Management or equivalent courses.
r: Monitor the EPC contractor HSE Management System and provide advice and assistance to EPC HSE managers so they comply in a consistent way to reduce the risk to the project employees and the environment.
Ensure the EPC contractors develop implement and maintain a specific project Risk Management Plan
Ensure EPC contractor subcontractor selection (ITB) processes are developed and implemented on a timely basis in accordance with KOC expectations.
Provide advice and guidance to the EPC contractor management team on HSE issues through the interpretation of KOC policies and statutory requirements.

Ensure EPC contractors establish and maintain statistical data concerning all matters of health and safety, training programs with which to provide a basis for development of further health and safety activities, to highlight trends for future action.

Monitor compliance with all Kuwait legislative requirements including the dissemination of information to PMC and EPC managers and employees regarding amendments/ additions to requirements as they come into effect.
Review EPC contractor Safety Management System and advise of required changes.
Develop and maintain professional relationships with KOC, regulatory bodies and EPC contractors to foster the professional image of KBR.

Visit the project site on a regular basis to ensure interest and awareness of HSE is maintained, conduct regular safety talks and safety training sessions relative to the nature of activities being undertaken
Other key activities shall include but not be limited to the following:
Pro-actively visit site and with the EPC contractor implement safety measures-promote/ensure safe work practices
Ensure quality safety observation program is implemented and maintained on each site/project and ensure follow up on findings
Assist EPC contractor construction management personnel in identifying hazards and in planning and organizing the work such that a safe working environment is maintained.
Assist EPC sub-contractor Safety advisors and site management in the development and revision of specific site safety programmes.
Maintain a HS&E audit and assessment program for the location.
Carry out regular inspections of the work areas with the respective EPC contractor line manager and or HSE representative and prepare reports.
Disseminate safety information throughout the workplace via bulletin boards, posters, newsletters etc.
Assist EPC contractor line management and or construction supervisors in accident investigation process and report accordingly.
Develop and implement safety initiatives to continually improve, achieve and maintain stated safety performance and objectives.
Ensure HSE safety inductions are undertaken in accordance with the EPC contractor SMS requirements for all new employees of the company and its subcontractors
Monitor the availability and use of safety apparel and equipment.
Provide advice to the EPC subcontractor supervision on the development of project specific procedures and Job Safety Analysis (JSA) training,
Advise subcontractor supervisory staff and employees in the implementation of strategies to identify and control potential hazards and in the use of the hierarchy of controls
Ensure all lines of communication on HSE-matters remain open and effective between all parties particularly KOC,KBR, EPC contractors and their sub-contractors.
